author: SketchyLiving
quote: THIS IS NOT JUST A GAME. THIS IS A PIECE OF MY LIFE.When I was a little kid, I used to play Ocarina of Time on the Nintendo 64 with my godbrother. We would sit there for hours, completely lost in Hyrule, exploring, laughing and experiencing something truly magical.I can still hear my mother calling from the kitchen: “The mini pizzas are ready!”We would run to the kitchen, grab our little pizzas, and rush straight back to the Nintendo 64.Those were the days. We didn’t know how precious those moments **** mother is no longer with us. She’s resting in her grave now, and I would give anything to hear her voice calling us from that kitchen one more **** here I am, all these years later, playing this masterpiece again on the Switch 2, this time with my own **** now I’m the one making the mini pizzas.Sometimes I look at my child playing, and tears of happiness fill my eyes. For a moment, I’m that little boy **** circle of life.This is what video games are supposed to be. Not just graphics, not just technology, but memories, emotions, family and magic that survive generations.Ocarina of Time is not just a 10/10. It’s a timeless masterpiece.Thank you, Nintendo. Thank you for giving me something I can pass on to my **** Mom, wherever you are, the mini pizzas are ready. ️THE GREATEST GAME OF ALL TIME.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: SketchyLiving
quote: 13 YEARS FOR THIS? WHAT A **** waited 13 damn years for this? Are you kidding me, Rockstar?I waited for Grand Theft Auto, not a relationship simulator where I have to run around doing chores for some narcissistic ex-con with a big ass, dealing with her drama and worrying about her kid.Half the missions feel like things I already have to do in real life. I play video games to escape that stuff, not to get a second job!And where the hell is the freedom? Everything feels sanitized, politically correct and afraid to offend somebody. GTA used to be wild, controversial, unpredictable and FUN. That’s what made it **** Dead Redemption 2 was a better game, with better writing, better characters and more soul. And we got that years ago!Thirteen years of waiting just to discover that GTA has lost its balls.This isn’t the GTA I grew up loving. It’s a glorified relationship drama with expensive graphics.What a waste of 13 years.
